text:
rachel: Quick note from an onboarding session — customer hit two SDK vs REST mismatches that are tripping folks up. Filing here so devex + SDK owners see them.

rachel: 1) Redirects: REST GET /v1/models/{id}/weights returns 307 to signed S3 url for some models. curl follows by default and downloads. Go SDK client returns the 307 status as an error (no follow).

rachel: repro: 
```bash
# REST (success)
curl -L -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/foo/weights -o weights.tar.gz

# Go SDK (error)
client.Models.DownloadWeights(ctx, "foo") // => error: 307 Temporary Redirect
```

rachel: 2) Param drift: REST accepts `timeout_ms` for long-poll endpoints, JS SDK uses `timeout` (seconds) which changed behavior and caused some onboarding scripts to hang for minutes.

noah: thanks, which go/js versions? are these in the quickstart samples?

rachel: Go 0.8.7, JS 0.9.4. yes — quickstart has the JS example that sets `timeout: 30` expecting ms; in our case that was interpreted as 30s and caused the SDK to retry aggressively.

sam: ack. redirect handling should be safe to follow for same-host 307s. we intentionally block cross-host redirects for security. if gateway returns signed S3 URL we should allow follow. i'll patch the Go transport to follow 307 when Location host matches allowed hosts or when header `x-allow-redirect: true` from gateway present.

sam: on the timeout param drift, sounds like we need a unify/alias in the JS SDK: accept both `timeout` (secs) and `timeout_ms`, prefer ms for parity and warn on deprecated usage. also update quickstarts.

rachel: customer also noted SDK error messages don't include the `Location` header on 307 responses which makes debugging harder.

sam: good point. i'll make sure the error wraps response headers so callers can see Location even if we error.

ci-bot: Created RED-3812: "SDK: follow same-host 307s for weights download; preserve Location in errors; unify timeout param names across SDKs" assigned to sam.

rachel: thanks. small UX ask: add a short note in the model serving docs about when the gateway will issue 307 (large artifacts) so integrators know to expect a signed redirect.

sam: will add doc note and a compatibility shim in Go + an alias in JS for `timeout_ms`. I'll also add an integration test that stubs a 307 + signed url flow.

rachel: amazing. i'll update the onboarding checklist to call out the param names and link this ticket.

sam: posting PR link when ready.

rachel: closing loop. :thumbsup:
